query:
SELECT fc.colaboradorId, c.nome, c.empresaSlug, fc.totalServicos, fc.totalGeral
FROM faturamentoColaboradores fc
JOIN colaboradores c ON c.id = fc.colaboradorId
WHERE fc.mes = 5 AND fc.ano = 2026 AND (c.nome LIKE '%Renan%' OR c.apelido LIKE '%Renan%');
